expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Returns the object short name. Returns the class-qualified object name, optionally stopping at StopOuter. Returns the object path, optionally stopping at StopOuter. Returns whether the object class is Class or derives from it. Returns whether Object is non-null and not pending destruction. Returns the class default object. Returns the source file that declares a script class, or an empty string. Returns the owning AngelScript module name for a script class. Returns the AngelScript type declaration for a script class. Returns whether a named function has a script implementation on this class.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: FName UObject.GetName() const; | FString UObject.GetFullName(const UObject StopOuter = nullptr) const; | FString UObject.GetPathName(const UObject StopOuter = nullptr) const; | bool UObject.IsA(const UClass Class) const; | bool IsValid(const UObject Object); | UObject UClass.GetDefaultObject() const; | FString UClass.GetSourceFilePath() const; | FString UClass.GetScriptModuleName() const; | FString UClass.GetScriptTypeDeclaration() const; | bool UClass.IsFunctionImplementedInScript(FName InFunctionName) const;
